task: SEPEM RDS v2 profiles and integral lambda squared
dataset: SEPEM Reference Data Set version 2.00, European Space Agency (2016)
wolf_monthly_convention: annual steps repeated 12 times; conditional mean-cycle scenario, not recovered COSRAD internals or a calendar forecast
tail_rule: last pair power law with slope at most -2, continued to 10000 MeV; model, not measured high-energy coverage
low_energy_rule: below 5 MeV excluded; all stopped in declared primary CSDA shields
status: conditional profile calculation; no normative replacement certificate
